priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned disposer
findings.body: `attach` still registers `handler`, but its returned cleanup function no longer calls `socket.off`. Consumers that dispose an attachment will continue receiving messages, and repeated attach/dispose cycles will accumulate listeners and retained references.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed disposer at line 3 remains an empty function. The full diff confirms this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so disposal still neither detaches callbacks nor releases the listener reference.
